As a certified leader in commercial e-waste recycling and data destruction, Elian Electronics Recycling partners with organizations of every scale — from local businesses and schools to national brands with complex asset management needs.

With secure processes, full compliance documentation, chain-of-custody reporting, and multi-state coverage, we help companies reduce risk, protect their data, and recycle responsibly.

Trusted by Businesses, Enterprises & Multi-Site Organizations Nationwide

Questions? We Have Answers

To qualify for our FREE e-waste pickup, your business must have at least 10 eligible items from our Qualified Items List. Once your items meet the minimum requirement, we’ll schedule a pickup at your convenience.


If you have fewer than 10 items, or a large item like a copier, we can still arrange a pickup for a small fee starting at $125. All pickups include secure handling and environmentally responsible recycling.


See if your items qualify: Check our Qualified Items List

Yes! We provide certified data destruction, both onsite and offsite, to ensure all sensitive information is securely destroyed.
